grid.queue_note: No new or increased connection capacity is available from the DSO in this metro before the 2030s. The existing firm capacity is therefore the asset, and the whole question is how much compute can be produced from it.

busway_ampacity_A.note: Legacy 400 A busway; modern AI halls use 800-1000 A

residual_air_capacity_kW_per_rack.note: Derived from hall design density and containment; confirm by measurement

btm_options.permitting_note: No combustion consent required; grid-code compliance and fire separation govern the programme.
Emissions consent and fuel supply are the schedule risk, not the equipment.

intake.engagement_recommendation: Complete intake. This supports a full Capacity & Density Envelope Study with site-specific conclusions.
